profile_text.body:
The website associated with this company presents Calgon Carbon, describing it as an activated carbon business focused on air and water purification. The site says modern communities face air and water purification challenges and that Calgon Carbon uses activated carbon to meet those needs. It names one product, FILTRASORB, described as a reagglomerated, coal-based activated carbon proven by over 40 years of success in applications such as TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in the process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial arenas. The site says FILTRASORB is made in the United States.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker CCC, with a CIK of 0001818201. Its recorded aliases are CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. and CCC INTELLIGENT SOLUTIONS HO. No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it. Its recorded legal exposure is in Illinois, with a count of 376.
